decisions.reason: Piqué upholstery is a core product with dedicated website promotion, indicating stable demand.
Semi-transparent bouclé-effect fabric has decorative appeal but is only mentioned, so it faces moderate risk.
Flame-retardant curtain fabric has a functional advantage and dedicated promotion, supporting continued market presence.
Double-face wool-blend decoration fabric is likely costly and niche with limited promotion, making it a candidate for discontinuation.
Semi-transparent wool bouclé leno fabric is very niche and not prominently promoted, suggesting weak market traction.
